tags.name: Gentle
tags.description: Haptics with low amplitude - barely perceptible vibration that stays in the background.

tags.name: Substantial
tags.description: Haptics with medium amplitude - a clear, balanced vibration that is easy to notice without being disruptive.

tags.name: Bold
tags.description: Haptics with high amplitude - a strong, attention-commanding vibration that is immediately felt.

tags.name: Soft
tags.description: Haptics with low frequency - a smooth, rounded vibration with a gentle, cushioned feel.

tags.name: Flexible
tags.description: Haptics with medium frequency - a balanced vibration that sits between soft and rigid.

tags.name: Rigid
tags.description: Haptics with high frequency - a crisp, precise vibration with a sharp, mechanical feel.

tags.name: Peak
tags.description: Haptics with a single amplitude peak - a quick rise and fall in intensity.

tags.name: Impulses
tags.description: Haptics with a discrete pattern - short, distinct pulses separated by silence.

tags.name: Solid
tags.description: Haptics with a long continuous pattern at a constant amplitude - a steady, uniform vibration.

tags.name: Bumps
tags.description: Haptics with multiple amplitude peaks - a series of rhythmic rises and falls.

tags.name: Saw
tags.description: Haptics with a sawtooth-shaped amplitude pattern - a sharp rise followed by an abrupt drop, or vice versa.

tags.name: Pattern
tags.description: Haptics with a custom, often repeating amplitude pattern - a structured sequence that defines a unique rhythm.

tags.name: Ramp
tags.description: Haptics with a ramp-shaped amplitude pattern - amplitude increases or decreases linearly over the duration.

tags.name: Impulse
tags.description: Extremely short haptic lasting less than 100 ms - an instantaneous tactile click.

tags.name: Short
tags.description: Brief haptic lasting between 100 ms and 250 ms - long enough to be clearly felt without lingering.

tags.name: Extended
tags.description: Medium-length haptic lasting between 250 ms and 600 ms - provides richer, more expressive feedback.

tags.name: Long
tags.description: Prolonged haptic lasting 600 ms or more - creates an immersive, sustained tactile experience.
